components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; font-size: 20px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--sticker); color: var(--sticker-ink); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -6px rgba(11, 11, 12, 0.5); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-sticker svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-sticker:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 9px 18px -8px rgba(11, 11, 12, 0.55); } .ds-sticker:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-sticker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 600px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 18px 18px 22px; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 62; font-size: 58px; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel-sub { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-rule-thick { border: 0; border-top: 9px solid var(--ink); margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-section { padding-top: 8px; } .ds-section + .ds-section { margin-top: 10px; border-top: 4px solid var(--ink); } .ds-head { margin: 0 0 4px; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; font-size: 20px; } .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-rows > li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 6px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); font-size: 15px; } .ds-rows > li:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-rows strong { font-weight: 800; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-num { font-weight: 800; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 75; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ticket { display: inline-flex; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); text-decoration: none; } .ds-ticket:hover { border-style: solid; color: var(--ink); } .ds-ticket:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--carton); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border: 3px solid currentColor; font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 62; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transform: rotate(-4deg); background: var(--panel); animation: ds-stamp 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-stamp small { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-stamp-block { color: var(--tamper); } .ds-stamp-allow { color: var(--ok); } @keyframes ds-stamp { from { transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1.6); opacity: 0; filter: blur(2px); } to { transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1); opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every agent's rules are printed like the regulated facts panel on an over-the-counter medicine carton. The page is the carton: one saturated electric cobalt field, edge to edge, with the product claim set huge and condensed on it. Centered on the carton sits a white Policy Facts panel, ruled in heavy and hairline black, carrying real chain data in a fixed order: Rules, Limits, Warnings, the attestation record, and Directions. The panel is never decorative; it is the content.

State owns the whole surface. A paused card does not get a small badge: the carton dims to slate and a red tamper strip crosses the top of the panel. The one action on any screen is a yellow highlight sticker. Origin tickets (dashed monospace stubs linking to a block, a tx, or the contract) sit beside the facts they prove, so every statement is checkable. The voice is plain and regulatory, never promotional; the system rejects the dark crypto dashboard with glowing edges and the three-feature-card SaaS landing.

Density is that of a printed label: tight rows, tabular numbers, short condensed heads. Motion is minimal and physical: rule rows print in once, simulator verdicts land as a pressed stamp.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated cobalt carton field per page; the panel is the only white surface.
A three-weight rule hierarchy (9px, 4px, 1px) does all structural work inside the panel.
Archivo Variable carries everything, with the width axis as the main expressive tool (62 for display, 75 for heads, 100 for reading).
Square corners everywhere; no radius in the system.
Yellow means the one action, red means blocked or paused, green means allowed or done.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A page has exactly one carton color filling the viewport, cobalt when live and slate when paused. No gradients, no second field color, no cards floating on a neutral background.

rules.name: The Signal Meaning Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the one action, red is blocked or paused, green is allowed or done. None of the three is used decoratively.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is expressed through `wdth` first (62, 75, 100), then weight. Display and stamps are wdth 62, heads and labels wdth 75, reading text wdth 100.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every number, rule number, limit value and count uses tabular figures so columns align like a printed label.

rules.name: The Only The Sticker Lifts Rule
rules.body: No panel, card, chip or input casts a shadow. The sticker is the only element allowed to sit above the print.

dos: **Do** keep one carton field per page: #1546ff live, #2b3352 paused, nothing else behind the panel.
**Do** structure the panel only with the 9px / 4px / 1px Label Ink rule hierarchy.
**Do** express type hierarchy through Archivo's width axis (62, 75, 100) before weight.
**Do** put an origin ticket beside any fact that chain data can prove.
**Do** use the yellow sticker for exactly one primary action per screen.
**Do** show the paused state on the whole surface (slate carton plus tamper strip), not as a badge alone.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number and mono for addresses, commands and hashes.
**Do** respect reduced motion: no stamp animation, no row print, no carton color transition.
donts: **Don't** round corners anywhere; the system radius is 0px.
**Don't** cast shadows from panels, chips, inputs or secondary buttons; only the sticker lifts.
**Don't** use yellow, red or green decoratively; each carries one meaning.
**Don't** build a dark crypto dashboard with glowing edges or a three-feature-card SaaS grid.
**Don't** fill the panel with decoration or invented data; it holds real card data or an honest empty state.
**Don't** show a name lookup next to an address; addresses appear as 0x values only.
